messages:
Marta: Heads-up for my handoff in ~30m. Running preflight for the EU release. Known noisy signals to watch: kv-prefetch latency spikes, encoder-pool jitter, and a bit of alert flapping on `prefetch_high_latency`. I'll keep this thread as the short watchlist.
Sam: Thanks — quick Q: did the KV-prefetch backfill finish? When did the last run complete?
Marta: Backfill finished ~12m ago per job-runner. Observed tail still high — p95 around 450ms on node pool `eu-prefetch-1`. Looks like possible cache-eviction thrash rather than steady load.
Jin: Noted. I saw something similar on staging after the kernel update last week. Could be driver/IO related. Can you drop the query link?
Marta: Link to dashboard: https://dash.redwood-infra.internal/d/prefetch/prefetch-latency?orgId=1. Alert rule excerpt below: 
```yaml
alert: PrefetchHighLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kv_prefetch_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, node)) > 0.35
for: 2m
```
Elena: :eyes: If SLOs aren't actually impacted we should mute the noise until we have a root cause. Sam — can you create a temporary silence and note it in the board?
Sam: Yep. I'll create a 2h silence in ~10m and add a note to the incident board. Planning to silence `prefetch_high_latency` alerts; will re-enable on morning shift unless we see regression.
InfraBot: Auto-note: Silence created by Sam; id=sil-78321; duration=2h.
Jin: Also flagging encoder node pool `enc-pool-3` — had 2 restarts in the last 6h (OOM candidates). I filed INF-2247 with logs and dmesg.
Marta: Added INF-2247 to this watchlist. If restarts continue we should consider rolling kernel or temporarily scaling the pool +1.
Elena: FYI EU capacity forecast shows a small utilization bump overnight. Keep an eye on burst queue depth. If queue_depth > 300 for >5m escalate.
Sam: I'll add a dashboard alert: queue_depth > 300 for 5m to page `eng-oncall-low`. Is that the right channel?
Marta: Yes, page `eng-oncall-low` for that threshold. Also: if p95 latency > 600ms for >3m page primary oncall. Runbook has the thresholds.
Elena: One more note — we disabled the older quantized fallback yesterday to test cost. Saw a minor cost uptick but no quality regressions; flagging for release notes.
Sam: Acknowledged. Handoff complete — I'm on for the next 8h. Ping me here or @oncall if anything flaps. :thumbsup:
